subject: pol-dym
title: (R)POL.DYM.------TRS.
description: Diagram in MID-W-3, paired with v1-p409-1. (R)POL-DYM (the reality of political dynamics) is crossed with TRS (transition). (R)POL-DYM is fed by RE-ST (restructuralism), and outputs to TRS. CUL-TF-S (cultural transfer shifts) → TRS, and DEC (decentralization) → TRS — meaning transition is over-fed by three independent upstreams (real political dynamics, cultural transfer shifts, decentralization). TRS then outputs to ALT-F (alternative functionalism), GRAD (gradualism) → DOC (documentation), and MT-TFS-AT (multi-transfer-shift activity). Structural argument: real political dynamics produces transition only as one of three parallel inputs — cultural transfer shifts and decentralization being the other two. Once at transition, the productive outputs split into alternative functionalism (the desired output), gradualism → documentation (the gradualist capture chain), and multi-transfer-shift activity. The diagram thus diagrams the structural opportunity of the midwest movement Braxton describes: the AACM-like collective formations *added* decentralization as a third independent feed into transition, alongside the political-dynamics and cultural-transfer-shifts feeds — meaning the midwest's structural innovation was to make transition resilient against the gradualism→documentation capture chain by ensuring that decentralization remained operative as an alternative-functionalism upstream.
